I've created the implementation plan for adding gallery call-to-action styles. Here's a summary:

## Implementation Plan Created

**Feature:** Add Gallery Call-to-Action Styles

### Analysis Summary
- The `.gallery-cta` class is used in **2 locations**:
  1. `src/index.njk` (line 171) - Main gallery section CTA inviting atelier visits
  2. `src/gallery.njk` (line 55) - Photo gallery page CTA linking to paintings/exhibitions
- Currently **no CSS styling exists** for this class
- The site uses a well-structured CSS design system with custom properties (design tokens)

### Plan Overview

**Phase 1: Implementation** (3 subtasks)
| Subtask | Title | Effort |
|---------|-------|--------|
| 1.1 | Add base .gallery-cta styles (background, padding, border-radius, margins) | Small |
| 1.2 | Style typography and links (font, colors, accent links, hover states) | Small |
| 1.3 | Add responsive styles for mobile/tablet | Small |

**Phase 2: Verification** (1 subtask)
| Subtask | Title | Effort |
|---------|-------|--------|
| 2.1 | Build and verify visual output on both pages | Small |

### Key Design Decisions
- Use existing design tokens for consistency (`--color-background-alt`, `--spacing-lg`, `--radius-md`)
- Apply accent color (`--color-accent: #FF1493`) to links for visual prominence
- Add subtle border and background to distinguish CTA from regular content
- Ensure responsive behavior across all viewports

The plan is ready for implementation. Would you like me to proceed with building this feature?
